import nanosurf
import time
import os

# Load application
spm = nanosurf.SPM()
application = spm.application

# Get all necessary objects
scan = application.Scan
opmode = application.OperatingMode
head = application.ScanHead

# Set operating mode to tapping mode (PhaseContrast) to minimize tip damage
opmode.OperatingMode = spm.OperatingMode.PhaseContrast

# Set scan parameters for 30x30 µm² image
scan.ImageWidth = 30e-6  # 30 µm in meters
scan.ImageHeight = 30e-6  # 30 µm in meters
scan.Points = 128  # points per line
scan.Lines = 128  # lines per frame

# Set a filename for the scan
file_name = "topographic_scan_30um_"
application.SetGalleryHistoryFilenameMask(file_name)

print(f"Scan parameters set:")
print(f"  Image size: {scan.ImageWidth*1e6} x {scan.ImageHeight*1e6} µm²")
print(f"  Resolution: {scan.Points} x {scan.Lines} pixels")
print(f"  Operating mode: Tapping mode (PhaseContrast)")
print(f"  Filename mask: {file_name}")

# Start the scan
print("\nStarting scan...")
scan.StartFrameUp()

# Wait for scan to complete
scanning = scan.IsScanning
while scanning:
    remaining_lines = scan.Lines - scan.Currentline
    print(f"Scanning in progress... Remaining lines: {remaining_lines}")
    time.sleep(3)
    scanning = scan.IsScanning

print("Scanning finished!")

# Get the workspace directory
workspace_dir = r"C:\Users\Admin\Desktop\corral\corral\tasks\afm\src\afm\claude-sonnet-4-5_subtasks_3_tool_calling_brief\enviroment\subtasks_3"
print(f"\nWorkspace directory: {workspace_dir}")

del spm
"}
